The Dragon Twins (2026) | Full Fantasy Movie in 4K

In a frozen northern gorge, an injured dragon shelters a young widow on the night the King's hunters take her husband away. By dawn she has become the mother of twins: a human boy… and a dragon with her own eyes.

The village calls one of them unnatural. She calls them both her sons.

For six years she hides the dragon in her barn — until the village comes at dawn with torches and ropes. Her dragon son escapes into the mountains. Her human son is taken by the man responsible for his father's disappearance and raised to become the best dragon tracker in the North.

Fifteen years later, the tracker finally corners the creature he was raised to pursue. He doesn't know it's his brother. And he doesn't know that the mother he mourns is still alive — held in a tower, singing to the dragons every night.

They took everything from her. Now the dragons answer to her.

An original story — written from imagination, not adapted from any book, film or legend.

This film contains AI-generated visuals and synthetic voices.
